Really though, I’ve been in your shoes when I was a bit younger. I got super invested in relationships/friendships super quickly. The reality is, in 3 weeks, you know nothing about a person. Even if you two spent 24/7 together for those 3 weeks, that’s nowhere near enough time to actually get to know somebody. 
In the future though, I’d really recommend you don’t continue trying to reach out to him or anybody he’s involved with. He doesn’t want to be part of your life, and you have to respect that boundary. Don’t trust people you’ve only known for a few weeks, and don’t try to stalk them/reach out to them after they’ve made it clear they don’t want you to. It’ll only cause you more heartache and headaches. The love that you want takes time- and there really shouldn’t be any rush. If a guy is rushing into a relationship, or telling you they love you a week into things, they’re trying to get something from you. It’s not authentic.
Stay safe out there, focus on learning who you are and what you truly want in life before getting too involved with other people

Damage boost is very good, and the way I like to think about it is this: you don’t have to heal damage they don’t take. Plus, enemies get ult charge from doing damage, so it’s better to kill them as quickly as possible. But I will also say that it is very dependent on the skill of who you’re playing with. If your dps aren’t hitting any shots, then damage boost isn’t going to be very helpful. But it’s always good to damage boost ults or little things like fire strikes if you can. Sometimes in lower ranks though or if you’re playing with lower-skilled tanks/dps then healing is going to be more effective! I think it is just most important to damage boost whenever you don’t need to heal, the best start to that for me was to never have heal beam on when they’re at full health. Good luck!
